news_cards.title: JP Ganga Path ko milega vishwashtariya swaroop
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne samagr vikas karyon me tezi lane ke diye nirdesh, 65 kilometer Ganga channel hoga viksit
Is project ka budget abhi tak nahin bataya gaya hai, lekin yeh Bihar ke liye ek bada infrastructure project hoga
Ganga path ke vikas se Bihar ke logon ko bahut fayda hoga, yeh project Bihar ke tourism ko bhi badhawa dega

news_cards.title: Bihar me nasha mukti abhiyan ke liye MoU sign kiya
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne nasha mukti abhiyan ke liye Brahmkumari sanstha ke saath MoU sign kiya
Is abhiyan ka uddeshya Bihar ke yuvaon ko nasha se door rakhna hai, ismein kai jagahon par camp lagaye jayenge
Nasha mukti abhiyan ke tahat yuvaon ko swasth jeevan jeene ke liye prerit kiya jayega, unhein rozgar ke avsar bhi pradan kiye jayenge

news_cards.title: Patna metro nirman ke dauran Nehru path par sugam yatra sunishchit karengi
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne Patna metro nirman ke dauran Nehru path par sugam yatra sunishchit karne ke nirdesh diye
Is project ka uddeshya Patna ke logon ko behtar yatra suvidha pradan karna hai, yeh project Patna ke infrastructure ko badhawa dega
Patna metro project ke tahat kai naye station banaye jayenge, yeh project Patna ke vikas ko badhawa dega

news_cards.title: Gaya me 6 hazar crore ki ekikrit ispat pariyojna ke liye MoU sign kiya
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne Gaya me 6 hazar crore ki ekikrit ispat pariyojna ke liye MoU sign kiya
Is pariyojna ka uddeshya Bihar ke arthik vikas ko badhawa dena hai, yeh pariyojna kai rozgar ke avsar pradan karegi
Ispat pariyojna ke tahat kai naye udyog lagaye jayenge, yeh pariyojna Bihar ke economy ko badhawa degi

news_cards.title: Bihar me sivil seva pariksha 2025 me safal yuvaon ne badhaya rajya ka gaurav
bullets: Bihar me sivil seva pariksha 2025 me kai yuvaon ne safalta haasil ki
In yuvaon ne apne gyaan aur mehnat se rajya ka gaurav badhaya hai, ve ab desh ke vibhinn padon par kaam karenge
Sivil seva pariksha ke tahat yuvaon ko desh ke vibhinn kshetron me kaam karne ka avsar milega, ve desh ke vikas me yogdan denge
